propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for inspecting held or orphaned write locks, requiring operators to manually inspect lock directories and owner stamps

rebar doctor must report four lock legs (tickets-write-fcntl, tickets-write-mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent state, and for the mkdir leg include v2 stamp fields (host/ns/pid/start), holder liveness, and hold age without mutating lock state
A write lock held by a live holder on the same host should not produce a finding and must not change exit code, while a stale or dead-holder lock must produce a finding and exit code 1
Holder liveness checking must be same-host only; foreign host or different pid namespace holders must report unprobeable verdict rather than pid guesses
Staleness determination must use exclusively lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale with no independent age threshold or pid probe heuristics elsewhere in the module
